column3: Outdated (conclusion B; ruling 2006-02-01): correct under the pre-2009 single once-per-combat 'becoming blocked' rule (old CR 309), which the CR later split into the forms of what is now 509.3a-d (in place by February 2011, probably with the M10 rules of 2009-07-10); CR 509.3d now makes a creature put onto the battlefield blocking trigger 'becomes blocked by a creature', so the new Aetherplasm triggers Deathgazer again (interpretation put-onto-battlefield-blocking-retriggers-becomes-blocked-by, provisional); the first sentence (it may put itself back) is tested in tests/rulings/r_p006_activated_bounce.rs
